tier_reason: Upgraded C->A: benchmark code is public (gauntlet/bench_1d_vs_mkl.c driven by gauntlet/gauntlet.py, raw csv records in gauntlet/results/gauntlet_2_4096_2026-09-23/), compiler GCC 15.2 and CPU i9-14900KF stated in README, flags public in gauntlet/build.py and CMakeLists.txt (-O3 -mavx2 -mfma -march=native -mno-avx512f).

corrections.claimed_speedup: 1D: 1.29x median over MKL across N=2..4,096 (89% of 4,095 lengths at/above parity; best 7.04x at N=89; powers of two 1.13x median, 75% at/above parity); 2D 1.34x median over 159 pow2 planes (94% at/above parity); 3D 1.55x median over 1,288 pow2 volumes (98% at/above parity) (README)
corrections.caveats: First-party benchmark (fully reproducible, but run by the author on one machine; harness hints at a Windows/vcpkg setup). Powers of two only 1.13x median over MKL with 25% of pow2 cells below parity. Speed on some large odd lengths comes from derived twiddles that trade accuracy (33 lengths have error above 1e-16; README says no accuracy mode is offered). docs/performance/v1_0_results.md has FFTW 3.3.10 comparisons for real r2c/c2r (mostly faster, some small-N losses, e.g. N=15 at 0.70x), not for the headline c2c table. Very new repo, 5 stars.
